item.title: Kim Nam-jun, 'Lee's Aide,' in Gyeyang-eul... Song Young-gil Receives Strategic Nomination in Yeonsu-gap (계양을 ‘李 측근’ 김남준... 연수갑 송영길 전략공천)
item.description:
Kim Nam-jun, 'Lee's Aide,' in Gyeyang-eul... Song Young-gil Receives Strategic Nomination in Yeonsu-gap (계양을 ‘李 측근’ 김남준... 연수갑 송영길 전략공천)

The Democratic Party of Korea decided on the 23rd to strategically nominate former leader Song Young-gil for the by-election of the Yeonsu-gap National Assembly seat in Incheon, held alongside the June 3 local elections, and Kim Nam-jun, former presidential spokesperson, for Gyeyang-eul in Incheon, which was President Lee Jae-myung’s former constituency. (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 인천 연수갑 국회의원 재·보궐선거에 송영길 전 대표, 이재명 대통령의 지역구였던 인천 계양을에는 김남준 전 청와대 대변인을 전략공천하기로 23일 결정했다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly on the 23rd, Kang Jun-hyun, the Democratic Party’s senior spokesperson, stated, “Yeonsu-gap in Incheon is not an easy district for our party, but it is a key strategic area we must secure. Considering the weight of former leader Song Young-gil, who served as a five-term lawmaker in Incheon, Incheon Mayor, and party leader—a valuable asset to our party—we have strategically deployed him.” (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 23일 국회에서 열린 기자회견에서 “인천 연수갑은 우리 당에 녹록지 않은 지역이자, 반드시 사수해야 할 핵심 전략 지역”이라며 “인천에서 5선 국회의원, 인천시장을 역임하고 당대표를 지낸 당의 소중한 자산인 송영길 전 대표의 중량감을 고려해 전략적으로 배치했다”고 했다.)

Kang further added, “Although he had to endure unjust sacrifices due to the Yoon Seok-yeol prosecution regime’s excessive targeted investigations, he left the party temporarily, proved his innocence, returned, and we judged him to be the most competitive candidate in Yeonsu-gap.” (또 강 수석대변인은 “윤석열 검찰 정권의 무리한 표적수사로 무고한 희생을 치러야 했으나, 당을 잠시 떠나 무죄를 입증하고 복귀했고 연수갑에서 가장 경쟁력 있는 후보라고 판단했다”고 했다.)

Shortly after the announcement of the nomination results that day, former leader Song expressed regret, saying, “I have repeatedly expressed my special affection and sense of responsibility for Gyeyang.” He added, “Though I must leave Gyeyang’s embrace, I think it fortunate that I am not leaving Incheon.” On the 24th, he plans to meet with residents of Gyeyang-gu to convey his gratitude. (이날 공천 결과 발표 직후 송 전 대표는 “그동안 여러 차례 계양에 대한 저의 남다른 애정과 책임감을 말씀드려왔다”며 아쉬움을 드러냈다. 그러면서 “비록 계양의 품을 떠나지만, 그래도 인천을 벗어나지 않게 되어 다행이라 생각한다”고 했다. 24일에는 계양구 주민들과 만나 위로 인사를 전할 예정이다.)

Regarding former spokesperson Kim, Kang stated, “He deeply understands President Lee’s governing philosophy, served President Lee Jae-myung during his time as a lawmaker, acquiring a high level of local knowledge, and as a former journalist and presidential spokesperson, he has proven his exceptional communication skills. He is a candidate who can accurately grasp the president’s intentions and swiftly resolve current issues, and we judged him to be the optimal talent to lead Gyeyang’s leap forward.” (김 전 대변인에 대해선 “이 대통령의 국정철학을 깊이 이해하고 있고, 이재명 대통령을 의원 시절에 보좌하면서 높은 지역 이해도를 갖췄을 뿐만 아니라 언론인 출신이자 청와대 대변인으로서 탁월한 소통능력을 증명했다”며 “대통령의 의중을 정확히 파악해 현안을 속도감있게 해결할 수 있는 후보이자 계양의 도약을 이끌 최적의 인재라 판단했다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Let Us Weather the Waves Together, Korea and Vietnam"...Lee Jae-yong: "I Will Speak Through Results" (李 “韓·베트남, 함께 파도 헤쳐가자“...이재용 “실적으로 말하겠다”)
item.description:
Lee: "Let Us Weather the Waves Together, Korea and Vietnam"...Lee Jae-yong: "I Will Speak Through Results" (李 “韓·베트남, 함께 파도 헤쳐가자“...이재용 “실적으로 말하겠다”)

President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Vietnam, stated on the 23rd at the "Korea-Vietnam Business Forum" held at a hotel in downtown Hanoi, "Our Republic of Korea government will serve as a sturdy compass and support for companies from both countries to navigate through turbulent waves and usher in a new era of prosperity." (베트남을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 23일 하노이 시내의 한 호텔에서 열린 ‘한·베트남 비즈니스 포럼’에서 “우리 대한민국 정부는 양국 기업이 험난한 파도를 헤치고 새로운 번영의 시대를 써 내려갈 수 있도록 든든한 나침반이자 버팀목이 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

President Lee addressed the more than 500 Korean and Vietnamese economic figures attending the forum, saying, "I ask that all of you here become the protagonists of that exciting voyage." <<> President Lee mentioned the global energy and supply chain crisis triggered by the Middle East war, and as a countermeasure, he said, "We must lay the foundation for unshakable supply chain and energy cooperation," adding, "Securing resources and energy stably is the only means to guarantee the sustainability of economic growth." <<> On the occasion of this summit, Korea and Vietnam agreed to strengthen cooperation in the energy sector, including nuclear power, renewable energy, and the construction of long-distance power grids. President Lee proposed jointly sowing seeds for future high-tech industries such as artificial intelligence and semiconductors, and preparing for the future together through science and technology cooperation. <<> President Lee also mentioned President Ho Chi Minh's adage, "To deal with all changes with the unchanging," revered as Vietnam's national father. President Lee stated, "The wisdom of 'responding to all changes with what does not change' is more urgent than ever," and "The unchanging friendship between our two countries, built over more than 30 years, is the most certain answer to the complex changes before us." <<> The business forum was attended by a large number of major group chairmen and CEOs. Participants included Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong, SK Chairman and Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry Chairman Chey Tae-won, LG Chairman Koo Kwang-mo, Lotte Group Chairman Shin Dong-bin, POSCO Holdings Chairman Jang In-hwa, HD Hyundai Chairman Chung Ki-sun, GS Chairman Huh Tae-soo, CJ Chairman Sohn Kyung-shik, Hyosung Chairman Cho Hyun-joon, Doosan Enerbility Chairman Park Ji-won, Daewoo E&C Chairman Jung Won-ju, Hyundai Motor Group President Sung Kim, and Naver CEO Choi Soo-yeon, who attended both the preliminary meeting and the main event. <<> When asked by reporters for his thoughts on participating in the India-Vietnam tour, Chairman Lee Jae-yong replied, "A businessman should speak through results." <<> Chairman Koo Kwang-mo said, "We have operations in India, and I hope this visit helps them progress even better," adding, "Korea and Vietnam already have extensive exchanges and active corporate presence. I hope this opportunity allows for development beyond quantity to quality." <<> Doosan Enerbility Chairman Park Ji-won expressed expectations for winning orders, saying, "Vietnam is currently planning to build a nuclear power plant, and at today's forum, I intend to mainly discuss our track record so far." <<> Following the forum, 74 memoranda of understanding (MOUs) were signed between companies from both countries. (이 대통령은 이날 포럼에 참석한 500여 명의 한·베트남 경제계 인사들에게 “이 자리에 계신 여러분께서 그 설레는 항해의 주인공이 되어 주시기 바란다”며 이같이 말했다.)

item.title: PM Kim Criticizes Island Expo Preparations: “Re-examine Concept and Transportation Issues” (섬 박람회 준비 상황 질타한 金총리 “콘셉트·교통 문제 재점검하라”)
item.description:
PM Kim Criticizes Island Expo Preparations: “Re-examine Concept and Transportation Issues” (섬 박람회 준비 상황 질타한 金총리 “콘셉트·교통 문제 재점검하라”)

Concerns have arisen that the Yeosu World Island Expo, opening in September, could become a “second Jamboree” due to insufficient preparations, prompting Prime Minister Kim Min-seok to visit Yeosu for the second time on the 23rd to inspect the situation. Prime Minister Kim pointed out a lack of engaging content for tourists at the expo and ordered Yeosu City to take responsibility and thoroughly reassess all preparations. (9월 개막하는 여수 세계 섬 박람회가 준비 부족으로 ‘제2의 잼버리’가 될 수 있다는 우려가 나오자 김민석 국무총리가 23일 두 번째로 여수를 찾아 준비 상황을 점검했다. 김 총리는 박람회에 관광객들이 와서 즐길 만한 콘텐츠가 부족하다고 지적하고, 여수시가 책임감을 갖고 준비 상황 전반을 재점검하라고 주문했다.)

On the morning of the 23rd, Prime Minister Kim inspected the Jinmo District in Dolsan-eup, Yeosu, South Jeolla Province, where the main venue construction is underway, and then moved to the Yeosu Youth Marine Education Center to chair a comprehensive inspection meeting. The meeting was attended by officials from the expo organizing committee and Yeosu City, South Jeolla Province Governor Kim Young-rok and provincial officials, as well as representatives from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries. (김 총리는 이날 오전 주행사장 공사가 진행 중인 전남 여수시 돌산읍 진모지구를 둘러본 뒤 여수청소년해양교육원으로 이동해 종합 점검 회의를 주재했다. 회의에는 박람회 조직위원회와 여수시 관계자, 김영록 전남지사를 비롯한 전남도 관계자, 행정안전부·문화체육관광부·국토교통부·해양수산부 관계자 등이 참석했다.)

Prime Minister Kim questioned why the 2012 Yeosu Expo site was not used as the main venue. Yeosu City explained that “the space needed to be secured eight months before the expo, but the Expo site was scheduled for sale, making it difficult.” Kim retorted, “That doesn’t resonate with me.” He added, “You say eight months of preparation are needed, but if you had prepared at the existing Expo site, couldn’t it have been done in about two months?” (김 총리는 2012 여수 엑스포가 열렸던 장소를 주행사장으로 쓰지 않은 데 대해 여수시가 ‘박람회 8개월 전부터 공간을 확보해 두어야 하는데 엑스포장은 매각 예정이라 어려웠다’는 취지로 설명하자 “와닿지 않는다”고 따졌다. 김 총리는 “8개월 전부터 준비해야 한다고 이야기하는데, 기 시설이 존재하는 엑스포장에서 준비했다면 2개월 정도면 될 수 있었던 것 아닌가”라고 했다.)

A Yeosu City official explained that the Expo site had already been leased out for restaurants, wedding halls, and cafes, and that the available space was insufficient for the expo’s requirements. In response, Prime Minister Kim criticized, “Hearing that explanation only raises more questions. There is social scrutiny over why the main venue wasn’t placed at the Expo site, yet you are not providing a clear explanation.” (여수시 관계자가 엑스포장은 이미 식당과 예식장, 카페 등으로 임대돼 있었고, 확보할 수 있는 공간이 박람회에 필요한 면적에 비해 부족했다는 등의 설명을 했다. 그러자 김 총리는 “그 설명을 듣고 오히려 의문이 생긴다”며 “왜 주 행사장을 엑스포장이 아닌 다른 곳에 했느냐에 대해 사회적인 문제 제기가 있는데, 명료하게 설명하지 않는다”고 비판했다.)

Prime Minister Kim also pointed out the unclear concept of the expo. He said, “When you call it an ‘Island Expo,’ does that mean visitors can come here and tour the islands, or experience them? There are several possibilities, but I hope the concept is clear.” Kim noted, “As it stands, the organizers can offer visitors the chance to come to the main venue, go inside facilities to view island-related content via videos, and take a 40-minute boat ride to a facility on one of several islands in Yeosu. But the organizers need to consider what tourists can actually enjoy and what will leave a lasting impression.” (김 총리는 박람회의 콘셉트가 명확하지 않다는 점도 지적했다. 김 총리는 “섬 박람회라고 하면 이곳에 와서 섬들을 둘러볼 수 있다는 것인지, 아니면 섬을 체험해볼 수 있다는 것인지, 몇 가지가 있을 텐데, 콘셉트가 명료했으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 김 총리는 “현재로서는 주 행사장에 와서 시설물 안에 들어가서 섬과 관련된 이모저모를 영상 등으로 둘러보고, 배를 40분 정도 타고 여수에 있는 여러 섬 중 한 곳에 있는 시설물에 가볼 수 있다는 것 정도가 주최 측이 보여줄 수 있는 것인데, 관광객 입장에서 즐길 수 있는 것이 무엇인지, 뭐가 남을지를 주최 측이 염두에 둬야 한다”고 지적했다.)

Prime Minister Kim emphasized that it must be made clear to the public that this expo, unlike the 2012 Yeosu Expo, is not a national-level event. He stated, “The Yeosu Island Expo is created by a local government and merely attaches the word ‘World’ to its name; it is different from the 2012 Yeosu Expo, which was an international event considered by the state.” He added, “There is a risk that people might mistakenly think, ‘Oh, another event like the Yeosu Expo.’ We need to clearly convey that this is not a national event. More than half of the budget and responsibility lies with Yeosu City.” (김 총리는 이번 박람회가 2012 여수 엑스포와 달리 국가적인 차원의 행사가 아니라는 점도 국민에게 알려야 한다고 강조했다. 그는 “여수 섬 박람회는 기초자치단체가 만들면서 이름에만 ‘세계’를 붙이는 것으로, 국가가 고민했던 국제 행사로서의 2012 여수 엑스포와는 다른 행사”라고 했다. 그러면서 “자칫하면 ‘여수 엑스포 같은 것을 또 하나 보다’라는 오해를 일으킬 수 있다”며 “이(국가적 행사가 아니라는) 부분을 명료하게 해야 한다”고 했다. “예산과 책임도 여수시에 반 이상이 있다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim identified transportation as the biggest risk factor. He said, “Even under normal circumstances, it’s not easy to handle transportation demand. During the expo period, the increased demand could cause inconvenience not only for tourists but also for residents. We should review all alternatives, including deploying yachts, but we must prepare on the premise that even those measures might not solve the problem.” (김 총리는 교통 문제를 가장 큰 위험 요소로 꼽았다. 김 총리는 “일상적인 상황에서도 교통 수요를 감당하기 쉽지 않은데, 박람회 기간에는 (수요 증가로) 관광객뿐 아니라 주민 불편까지 초래할 가능성이 있다”며 “요트 투입 등 모든 대안을 검토하되, 그것으로도 해결이 안 될 가능성을 전제로 준비해야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the controversy over Yeosu City spending 10.4 billion won to build an artificial island for the expo, Prime Minister Kim said, “The organizers should create a ‘Five Questions, Five Answers’ or ‘Ten Questions, Ten Answers’ document to explain and address public misunderstandings or criticisms.” (여수시가 박람회를 이유로 104억원을 들여 인공섬을 조성한다는 논란에 대해서는 “주최 측이 ‘5문 5답’이든 ‘10문 10답’이든 만들어서 국민적인 오해나 비판에 대해 설명하라”고 했다.)

South Jeolla Province Governor Kim Young-rok requested, “Even during the expo, I’d like to try a ‘half-price travel’ program to boost island tourism. Please provide at least some national funding.” Prime Minister Kim responded, “I’ll consider it.” (김영록 전남지사는 “박람회 중에라도 섬 관광 활성화를 위해 ‘반값 여행’ 프로그램을 해보고 싶다”며 “국비로 조금이라도 (지원해 달라)”고 요청했고, 김 총리는 “고민하겠다”고 했다.)

The Yeosu Island Expo sparked controversy earlier this month when a promotional video made by Yeosu City featuring Kim Seon-tae, a YouTuber known as “Chungju Man” and a former local government official, revealed the inadequate preparations. President Lee Jae-myung also mentioned at a cabinet meeting on the 14th, “There are voices of concern from the field. I hope the central government will inspect the preparations and provide support.” Prime Minister Kim’s inspection on the 23rd marks his second visit, following a tour of the sub-venue on Gae Island on the 16th. (여수 섬 박람회는 여수시가 이달 초 지자체 공무원 출신 유튜버 ‘충주맨’ 김선태씨를 불러 만든 홍보 영상을 통해 미흡한 준비 실태가 알려지면서 논란이 됐다. 이재명 대통령도 지난 14일 국무회의에서 “현장에서 우려의 목소리가 나온다”며 “중앙정부 차원에서 준비 상황을 점검하고 지원해주면 좋겠다”고 했다. 김 총리는 지난 16일 부행사장인 개도(섬)을 둘러본 데 이어 이번에 두 번째로 점검을 했다.)

item.title: "Park Chung-hee and Kim Dae-jung, despite differing philosophies, shared a common goal of 'national unity'" (“철학 달랐던 박정희·김대중도 ‘국민 통합’엔 한뜻”)
item.description:
"Park Chung-hee and Kim Dae-jung, despite differing philosophies, shared a common goal of 'national unity'" (“철학 달랐던 박정희·김대중도 ‘국민 통합’엔 한뜻”)

Amid intensifying confrontation between the ruling and opposition parties ahead of the June 3 local elections, an unusual conference was held where participants shouted "Kim Dae-jung" in response to the moderator's call of "Park Chung-hee." On the 23rd, the Park Chung-hee Academy and the Yonsei University Kim Dae-jung Library jointly held a conference at the Seoul Global Center Building under the theme "The Legacy and Lessons of Park Chung-hee and Kim Dae-jung's Leadership for National Unity." This followed last year's well-received academic conference between the two presidential commemoration organizations, which explored "Korea-Japan relations opened by Park Chung-hee and expanded by Kim Dae-jung" on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the normalization of diplomatic ties between Korea and Japan. (6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 여야 대립이 첨예화하는 상황에서 사회자가 ‘박정희’를 외치자 참석자들이 ‘김대중’을 외치는 이례적인 회의가 개최됐다. 박정희학술원과 연세대 김대중도서관은 23일 서울글로벌센터빌딩에서 ‘국민 통합을 위한 박정희·김대중 리더십의 유산과 교훈’을 주제로 공동 회의를 개최했다. 지난해 두 대통령 기념 사업 기관이 한일 국교 정상화 60주년을 계기로 ‘박정희가 열고, 김대중이 넓힌 한일 관계’를 다룬 학술 회의가 호평받자 2차 회의를 개최한 것이다.)

In his opening speech, Choi Dae-seok, Chairman of the Park Chung-hee Academy, stated, "Our society is currently engaged in a political civil war." He added, "Park Chung-hee and Kim Dae-jung had different circumstances and governing philosophies, but they were both proactive in uniting the people's strength to lead the community. We must heed that lesson and seek a path toward national unity." Park Myung-rim, Director of the Kim Dae-jung Library, said in his welcome address, "Following last year, we determined that leaving the conflicts and confrontations in our society as they are would be inconsistent with the founding spirit and philosophy of our institutions." He added, "The current conflicts have exceeded what a single community can bear, and there is a need for institutionalized public channels to address them." (최대석 박정희학술원 이사장은 개회사에서 “지금 우리 사회는 정치적 내전을 치르고 있다”며 “박정희, 김대중 두 분은 시대적 조건과 국정 철학은 달랐지만 공동체를 이끌기 위해 국민의 힘을 하나로 모아야 한다는 점에서 적극적이었는데, 그 교훈을 새겨서 국민 통합의 길을 모색해야 한다”고 했다. 박명림 김대중도서관장은 환영사에서 “지난해에 이어 두 기관이 우리 사회의 갈등과 대립을 그대로 두는 것은 설립 정신과 철학에 비춰 바람직하지 않다고 판단했다”며 “현재의 갈등은 한 공동체가 감당할 수 있는 수준을 넘고 있는데, 이를 공적 수렴하는 제도화가 필요하다”고 했다.)

Panelists at the conference agreed that the current level of division and conflict is severe. Professor Lee Jong-soo of Yonsei University noted, "Through the two presidential impeachments in 2017 and 2025, political and social conflicts have become far more intense than in the past." Professor Kang Won-taek of Seoul National University pointed out, "In a 2022 Pew Research Center survey of 19 countries, South Korea emerged as the nation where people feel the most severe conflict caused by politics." Professor Emeritus Jeon Sang-in of Seoul National University remarked, "The political sphere has become not a solver of conflict but an amplifier. The nation is festering internally due to minimal conflict management." (이날 회의에 참석한 패널들은 현재의 분열과 갈등이 심각한 수준이라는 데 의견이 일치했다. 이종수 연세대 교수는 “지난 2017년과 2025년 두 차례 대통령 탄핵을 거치면서 정치·사회적 갈등이 과거에 비해 -극심해졌다”고 했다. 강원택 서울대 교수는 “2022년 미국의 퓨 리서치가 19국을 대상으로 조사한 결과 한국은 정치로 인한 갈등을 가장 심하게 느끼는 나라로 나타났다”고 했다. 전상인 서울대 명예교수는 “정치권이 갈등의 해결 주체가 아니라 증폭의 주체가 됐다. 최저 수준의 갈등 관리에 국가가 안으로 곪아가고 있다”고 지적했다.)

The panelists argued that, to resolve the severe political conflicts in our society, President Lee Jae-myung should actively pursue national unity, carrying forward the legacy of former Presidents Park Chung-hee and Kim Dae-jung. (패널들은 우리 사회의 심각한 정치적 갈등 해소를 위해 이재명 대통령이 박정희·김대중 전 대통령의 뜻을 이어서 국민 통합에 적극 나서야 한다고 주장했다.)

Professor Kang Won-taek noted that President Lee's mention of both former presidents in his inaugural address was noteworthy. He recalled President Lee's statement in his inaugural speech: "From now on, there are no progressive issues. From now on, there are no conservative issues either. If Park Chung-hee's policies or Kim Dae-jung's policies are necessary and useful, I will use them without distinction." He emphasized the urgent need to translate this will for unity into concrete achievements. Professor Jeon Sang-in said, "Former President Kim Dae-jung refrained from political retaliation, embraced his political opponents, and forgave them," suggesting that President Lee should pay attention to this approach. (강원택 교수는 이 대통령이 취임사에서 두 대통령을 동시에 언급한 것에 주목한다고 했다. 그는 이 대통령이 취임사에서 “이제부터 진보의 문제란 없다. 이제부터 보수의 문제도 없다. 박정희 정책도 김대중 정책도 필요하고 유용하면 구별 없이 쓰겠다”고 한 것을 상기시키며 통합 의지를 구체적 성과로 이뤄내려는 노력이 절실하다고 했다. 전상인 교수는 “김대중 전 대통령은 정치 보복을 자제하고, 정적을 포용하며 용서했다”며 이 대통령이 이에 주목할 필요가 있다고 했다.)

Professor Yun Pyung-joong warned, "The Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party's dismantling of democracy through democratic means by prioritizing majority rule represents a massive historical regression." He added, "This directly conflicts with the Democratic Party's traditions and could even undermine the positive functions and achievements of the Lee Jae-myung administration." Professor Lee Jong-soo pointed out, "While President Lee works pragmatically, there is much to be desired in terms of political reflection," and noted, "From the perspective of social integration, the current weakness of the opposition party is also a factor in the crisis." After the conference, during dinner, Chairman Choi Dae-seok stood up to propose a toast and asked, "When I shout 'Park Chung-hee,' please respond with 'Kim Dae-jung,'" leading to the two presidents' names echoing in succession. (윤평중 교수는 “이재명 정부와 민주당이 다수결을 앞세워 민주주의를 민주적 수단으로 해체하는 것은 거대한 역사적 퇴행”이라며 “이는 민주당의 전통과도 정면으로 충돌하며 이재명 정부의 순기능과 긍정적 성과조차 무너뜨릴 수 있다”고 경고했다. 이종수 교수는 “이 대통령이 실용적으로 일을 하나, 정치적 성찰 측면에서 아쉬움이 많다”고 지적한 뒤 “사회적 통합의 관점에서 볼 때 현재 야당이 허약한 것도 위기의 한 요인”이라고 했다. 이날 회의 후, 저녁 식사 자리에서 건배사를 하기 위해 일어선 최대석 이사장이 “내가 ‘박정희’를 외치면, ‘김대중’으로 화답해 달라”고 해, 두 대통령 이름이 잇달아 울려 퍼졌다.)

item.title: ‘75th Anniversary Ceremony of the Commonwealth Gapyeong Battle’ to Be Held (‘영연방 가평전투 75주년 기념식’ 열린다)
item.description:
‘75th Anniversary Ceremony of the Commonwealth Gapyeong Battle’ to Be Held (‘영연방 가평전투 75주년 기념식’ 열린다)

The Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs announced on the 23rd that the ‘75th Anniversary Ceremony of the Commonwealth Gapyeong Battle’ will be held on the 24th at the Commonwealth War Memorial in Gapyeong, Gyeonggi Province, hosted by the British Embassy in South Korea. The event aims to honor the contributions of the heroes who fought in the Gapyeong Battle, one of the fiercest engagements of the Korean War, and to commemorate the fallen. (국가보훈부는 24일 경기도 가평에 있는 영연방 참전기념비에서 주한 영국 대사관 주관으로 ‘영연방 가평전투 75주년 기념식’이 개최될 예정이라고 23일 밝혔다. 6·25전쟁 최대 격전 중 하나인 가평전투 참전 영웅들의 공헌을 기리고, 희생자들을 추모하기 위한 행사다.)

The Gapyeong Battle took place over three days from April 23 to 25, 1951, where approximately 2,000 soldiers of the 27th Commonwealth Brigade fiercely fought against over 10,000 Chinese troops—more than five times their number—and successfully halted their southward advance. This battle enabled the South Korean and UN forces to establish new defensive positions. In the Gapyeong Battle, 47 soldiers of the 27th Commonwealth Brigade were killed, three went missing, and 99 were wounded. However, Chinese casualties reached around 1,000. It was regarded as a ‘great victory’ not only in South Korea but also in world military history. <<> The ceremony will be attended by approximately 300 people, including Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Kang Oh-eul, British Ambassador to South Korea Colin Crooks, ambassadors from the other three Commonwealth nations (Canada, Australia, and New Zealand), Army Chief of Staff Kim Kyu-ha, the army chiefs of staff of the four Commonwealth nations, Deputy Commander of the ROK-US Combined Forces Command Kim Seong-min, Deputy Commander of the UN Command Winter Scott, Commander of the US Eighth Army Joseph Hilbert, and Defense Acquisition Program Administration Commissioner Lee Yong-chul. Notably, seven Commonwealth war veterans invited by the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, along with their families, and two South Korean war veterans will also attend. <<> The ceremony will proceed in the following order: the entry of the UN Command color guard, the reading of the British King’s message by Ambassador Crooks, commemorative speeches by Minister Kang and Chief of Staff Kim, a eulogy by the UN Command chaplain, a moment of silence, a wreath-laying ceremony, and a memorial flight by the Republic of Korea Air Force’s special aerobatic team, the ‘Black Eagles.’ <<> The day before the Gapyeong Battle ceremony, on the 23rd, the ‘UK Imjin River Battle Ceremony’ was also held at the Seolmari Battle Memorial Park in Paju, Gyeonggi Province. The Imjin River Battle took place around the same period, from April 22 to 25, 1951, in the areas of Hill 235 in Seolmari, Jeokseong-myeon, Paju, and the Imjin River region, where the British Gloucestershire Battalion fought a bloody battle against three Chinese divisions, successfully delaying the Chinese advance southward for a considerable time. <<> Minister Kang stated, “The courage and fighting spirit of the Commonwealth war heroes who fought fiercely for freedom in the rugged mountains and fields of Gapyeong 75 years ago have become the solid foundation of the peace and prosperity that South Korea enjoys today. We will make multifaceted efforts to remember the sacrifices and dedication of the Commonwealth war veterans and to ensure that future generations continue this noble bond of blood alliance.” <<> Ambassador Crooks said, “The sacrifices of British soldiers are the source of the deep and enduring partnership between our two countries today. The United Kingdom will continue to cooperate for the security, peace, and stability of the Republic of Korea.” (가평전투는 1951년 4월 23~25일 사흘 동안 영연방군 제27여단 용사 2000여명이 5배가 넘는 1만여명의 중공군과 치열하게 싸워 남하를 저지하는 데 성공한 전투다. 이 전투를 계기로 국군과 유엔군이 새로운 방어진지를 구축할 수 있었다. 가평 전투로 영연방 27여단 장병 47명이 전사하고 3명이 실종됐으며, 99명이 부상하는 희생을 겪었다. 그러나 중공군 사망자는 1000여 명에 달했다. 국내 뿐만 아니라 세계 전쟁사에서도 손꼽히는 ‘대승’이었다.)

item.title: Sejong, the 'Young City,' Sees Four-Way Race with Conservative Advantage... Administrative Capital Status as Top Issue (‘젊은 도시’ 세종, 與 우세속 4파전… 행정수도가 최대 현안)
item.description:
Sejong, the 'Young City,' Sees Four-Way Race with Conservative Advantage... Administrative Capital Status as Top Issue (‘젊은 도시’ 세종, 與 우세속 4파전… 행정수도가 최대 현안)

In the June 3 Sejong mayoral election, contenders include Cho Sang-ho (56), former Deputy Mayor for Economy of Sejong under the Democratic Party of Korea; incumbent Mayor Choi Min-ho (70) of the People Power Party; Representative Hwang Un-ha (64) of the Rebuilding Korea Party; and Ha Heon-hwi (40), chair of the Sejong City Party Formation Preparatory Committee for the Reform Party. (6·3 세종시장 선거에선 더불어민주당의 조상호(56) 전 세종시 경제부시장과 국민의힘의 최민호(70) 현 세종시장, 조국혁신당의 황운하(64) 의원, 개혁신당의 하헌휘(40) 세종시당 창당준비위원장이 맞붙는다.)

Former Deputy Mayor Cho served as an aide to former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan when he was a lawmaker and held positions such as the Democratic Party's political coordination office director. He ran for Sejong mayor in 2022 but lost in the party primary to former Mayor Lee Chun-hee. This time, he defeated former Lee to become the Democratic Party's candidate. (조 전 부시장은 이해찬 전 총리가 국회의원을 할 때 보좌관을 지냈고 민주당 당대표 정무조정실장 등을 거쳤다. 2022년 세종시장 선거에 도전했으나 민주당 경선에서 이춘희 전 세종시장에 밀렸다. 이번에는 이 전 시장을 이기고 민주당 후보가 됐다.)

Mayor Choi has served as Vice Governor of South Chungcheong Province, head of the Administrative Complex City Construction Agency, and chief of staff to the Prime Minister. In the 2022 election, he defeated former Mayor Lee Chun-hee, who was seeking a third term. (최 시장은 충남도 행정부지사, 행정중심복합도시건설청장, 국무총리 비서실장 등을 지냈다. 2022년 선거에서 3선에 도전한 이춘희 전 세종시장을 꺾었다.)

Representative Hwang served as the National Police Agency's investigation planning officer and head of the Daejeon Metropolitan Police before being elected as a lawmaker (for Daejeon's Jung-gu district) under the Democratic Party in 2020. He was re-elected as a proportional representative for the Rebuilding Korea Party in 2024 and has now entered the Sejong mayoral race. (황 의원은 경찰청 수사기획관, 대전경찰청장 등을 거쳐 2020년 더불어민주당 소속으로 국회의원(대전 중구)에 당선됐다. 2024년 조국혁신당 비례대표로 재선했고 이번에 세종시장 선거에 뛰어들었다.)

Chairman Ha is a lawyer who has served as a Sejong City hearing commissioner and auditor for the Sejong Center for Creative Economy and Innovation. (하 위원장은 변호사로 세종시 청문위원, 세종창조경제혁신센터 감사 등을 맡았다.)

In a poll conducted by JoWon C&I and Research & Research commissioned by TJB on the 18th and 19th, former Deputy Mayor Cho recorded 44.9%, Mayor Choi 19.7%, Representative Hwang 8.4%, and Chairman Ha 1%. The survey involved 806 Sejong residents aged 18 and older. It was conducted via ARS (automated response) with a response rate of 11.7% and a margin of error of ±3.5 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission.) (지난 18~19일 TJB 의뢰로 조원씨앤아이·리서치앤리서치가 실시한 여론조사에선 조 전 부시장이 44.9%, 최 시장이 19.7%, 황 의원이 8.4%, 하 위원장이 1%를 기록했다. 이 조사에는 세종시에 사는 18세 이상 시민 806명이 참여했다. ARS(자동 응답) 방식으로 실시됐으며 응답률은 11.7%, 표본오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.5%포인트다.(중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 참조))

Election experts analyze, "After the recent failure to unite former Deputy Mayor Cho and Representative Hwang, progressive-leaning voters seem to be consolidating around former Deputy Mayor Cho." Representative Hwang stated, "The unification is off," adding, "Now the only thing left is to win in a multi-party race." Former Deputy Mayor Cho said on the 17th, "I spoke with (Representative Hwang), but we didn't have a concrete discussion (on unification). It's not a matter for individual candidates to decide." (선거 전문가들은 “최근 조 전 부시장과 황 의원의 단일화가 무산된 이후 진보 성향 표심이 조 전 부시장 쪽으로 결집하는 것 같다”고 분석했다. 황 의원은 “단일화는 무산됐다”면서 “이제 다자 구도에서 승리하는 일만 남았다”고 했다. 조 전 부시장은 지난 17일 “(황 의원과) 통화했지만 구체적인 (단일화) 논의는 하지 못했다”면서 “후보 개인이 결정할 문제가 아니다”라고 말했다.)

Sejong City is the youngest city among the 17 metropolitan cities and provinces nationwide. Among its population of 390,000, 130,000 are in their 30s and 40s, accounting for one in three residents. Professor Choi Ho-taek of Baekseok University said, "Sejong is home to many young government officials and newlyweds who moved from the Chungcheong region," adding, "This is why progressive tendencies are relatively dominant." (세종시는 전국 17개 시·도 중 가장 젊은 도시다. 인구 39만명 중 30·40대가 13만명이다. 3명 중 1명꼴이다. 최호택 배재대 교수는 “세종시에는 정부 부처의 젊은 공무원과 충청권에서 옮겨온 신혼부부 등이 많이 산다”며 “이 때문에 진보 성향이 우세한 편”이라고 했다.)

The biggest issue in Sejong is 'completing the administrative capital.' On the 15th, the government announced a tender for constructing the site for the presidential office in Sejong. However, on the 22nd, the National Assembly's Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Committee's bill review subcommittee deferred the 'Special Act on Building the Administrative Capital.' The Sejong Decentralization Council, a civic group, stated, "The president ordered speed in building the Sejong office, but the National Assembly couldn't even finalize the special law," adding, "The government is moving forward while the legislature remains stagnant." The special bill includes provisions to designate Sejong as the administrative capital and to establish the National Assembly and presidential office there. Former Deputy Mayor Cho commented, "This is disappointing and regrettable news for Sejong citizens who have waited long for the bill's passage," adding, "I will meet with the Democratic Party leader and earnestly request the passage of the special administrative capital law." Mayor Choi said, "Politicians mindful of the Seoul metropolitan area are calculating votes," adding, "I will fight until the end alongside Sejong citizens to complete Sejong as the administrative capital." (세종시의 최대 현안은 ‘행정수도 완성’이다. 정부는 지난 15일 대통령 세종 집무실 부지 조성 공사 입찰 공고를 냈다. 하지만 22일 국회 국토교통위원회 법안심사소위원회에서 ‘행정수도 건설 특별법’이 보류됐다. 시민 사회 단체인 지방분권세종회의는 “대통령은 세종 집무실 건설에 속도를 내라고 지시했는데 국회는 특별법조차 매듭짓지 못했다”면서 “정부는 앞으로 나아가는데 입법부는 제자리걸음을 하고 있다”고 했다. 특별법안에는 세종시를 행정수도로 명시하고 국회와 대통령 집무실을 설치한다는 내용이 담겼다. 조 전 부시장은 “법안 통과를 오랫동안 기다려온 세종 시민에게 아쉽고 송구한 소식”이라며 “민주당 당대표와 만나 행정수도 특별법 처리를 간곡하게 요청할 것”이라고 말했다. 최 시장은 “수도권을 의식한 정치권이 표 계산을 하고 있다”며 “행정수도 세종이 완성되도록 세종 시민 곁에서 끝까지 싸우겠다”고 말했다.)

The fate of the Sejong Weir is also an issue. The weir was installed on the Geum River flowing through Sejong in 2012. It was halted and its gates fully opened during the Moon Jae-in administration in 2018. The Yoon Suk Yeol administration attempted to restart the gates but has been stopped by opposition from environmental groups. Former Deputy Mayor Cho opposes restarting the weir. He stated, "We need to consider ways to restore the ecology of the Geum River and maximize its value." In contrast, Mayor Choi said, "The Sejong Weir is essential infrastructure protecting citizens from floods and droughts," adding, "Restarting the gates could also boost water leisure and tourism industries." (세종보 존폐도 이슈다. 세종보는 2012년 세종시를 흐르는 금강에 설치됐다. 2018년 문재인 정부 시절 가동을 중단하고 수문을 완전 개방했다. 윤석열 정부는 수문을 재가동하려고 했으나 환경단체의 반발로 멈춰 있다. 조 전 부시장은 세종보 재가동에 반대하고 있다. 조 전 부시장은 “금강의 생태계를 복원하고 가치를 극대화할 방법을 고민해야 한다”고 말했다. 반면 최 시장은 “세종보는 홍수와 가뭄으로부터 시민을 지키는 기반 시설”이라며 “수문을 재가동해 수상 레저·관광 산업을 키울 수도 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Park Seon-gyu, Who Switched to the Democratic Party, Seeks Fourth Term… Conservative Vote Splits Between Kim Gil-su and Choi Myeong-seo (與로 당 옮긴 박선규, 4선 도전… 보수는 김길수·최명서로 갈려)
item.description:
Park Seon-gyu, Who Switched to the Democratic Party, Seeks Fourth Term… Conservative Vote Splits Between Kim Gil-su and Choi Myeong-seo (與로 당 옮긴 박선규, 4선 도전… 보수는 김길수·최명서로 갈려)

The election for Yeongwol County Governor in Gangwon Province, scheduled for June 3, is drawing attention over whether a ‘four-term county governor’ will emerge and whether conservative votes will be split. Park Seon-gyu (69), a former county governor who served three terms under the People Power Party, has moved to the Democratic Party of Korea to challenge for a fourth term, while the incumbent Governor Choi Myeong-seo (70), who was ‘cut off’ (excluded from candidacy) by the People Power Party, is running as an independent. The person nominated by the People Power Party is Gangwon Provincial Council member Kim Gil-su (66). Eom Sam-yong (59), head of the Governance Division of the Han River Basin Water Management Committee from the Rebuilding Korea Party, has also entered the race, making it a four-way contest. (6월 3일 열리는 강원 영월군수 선거는 ‘4선 군수’ 탄생 여부와 보수 표심 분열 여부로 주목받고 있다. 국민의힘 소속으로 3선을 지낸 박선규(69) 전 군수가 더불어민주당으로 옮겨 4선에 도전하고, 국민의힘에서 ‘컷오프(공천 배제)’된 최명서(70) 현 군수는 무소속으로 출마했다. 국민의힘 공천을 받은 인물은 김길수(66) 강원도의원이다. 조국혁신당 엄삼용(59) 한강유역물관리위원회 거버넌스 분과장도 출마해 4파전으로 치러진다.)

Former Governor Park, the Democratic Party candidate, first won the Yeongwol County Governor position in 2006 under the Grand National Party (predecessor of the People Power Party) and went on to serve three consecutive terms. Due to the three-term limit, he did not run in 2018. He applied for nomination in the 2022 local elections but was cut off. He ran as an independent in that election but was defeated. Last year, he switched his party affiliation to the Democratic Party. Former Governor Park said, “The party change is a shift from ideology to pragmatism.” If Park is elected this time, he will become a ‘four-term county governor.’ <<> Provincial Council member Kim, the People Power Party candidate, served as Director of the Gangwon Provincial Disaster and Safety Office and President of the Gangwon Development Corporation before being elected to the Gangwon Provincial Council in the 2022 local elections. After incumbent Governor Choi Myeong-seo, who was a member of the People Power Party, was cut off from nomination, Provincial Council member Kim received the sole nomination from the People Power Party. Provincial Council member Kim stated, “Based on my administrative experience, I will attract strategic investments to Yeongwol and create an abundance of jobs and entrepreneurial opportunities.” <<> Rebuilding Korea Party candidate Eom has been involved in efforts to protect the water quality of the Donggang River and oppose the Donggang Dam. He opened his election office on the 29th of last month and launched his full-fledged campaign. Party leader Cho Kuk also attended the event. <<> Incumbent Governor Choi Myeong-seo, who is seeking a third term, was elected in 2018 and 2022, making him a two-term governor. However, this time he was unable to even participate in the People Power Party primary and was cut off. The People Power Party explained, “We judged that we needed to discover a competitive candidate and differentiate ourselves.” In response, Governor Choi declared, “I will directly seek the judgment of the county residents,” and decided to run as an independent. <<> In the election for Jeongseon County Governor in Gangwon Province, incumbent Democratic Party Governor Choi Seung-jun (70), former Kangwon Land Vice President Choi Cheol-gyu (61) of the People Power Party, and independent candidate and Jeongseon County Council Chairman Jeon Yeong-gi (52) are expected to face off. In a wireless telephone survey conducted by Ace Research commissioned by Gangwon Ilbo on the 17th and 18th targeting 504 men and women aged 18 and over living in Jeongseon, support rates were as follows: Governor Choi Seung-jun 48.8%, former Vice President Choi Cheol-gyu 40.2%, and County Council Chairman Jeon Yeong-gi 4.6%. The margin of sampling error is ±4.4 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. A local political source commented, “In Yeongwol, whether conservative votes will be split will be the deciding factor, while in Jeongseon, it will be about the evaluation of the incumbent governor.” (민주당 후보인 박 전 군수는 2006년 한나라당(국민의힘의 전신) 소속으로 처음 영월군수에 당선된 뒤 내리 3선을 지냈다. 3선 연임 제한 탓에 2018년엔 출마하지 않았다. 2022년 지방선거에 공천을 신청했다가 컷오프됐다. 이 선거엔 무소속으로 출마했지만 낙선했다. 지난해 민주당으로 당적을 옮겼다. 박 전 군수는 “(당적 변경은) 이념에서 실용으로의 전환”이라고 했다. 박 전 군수가 이번에 당선되면 ‘4선 군수’가 된다.)

item.title: The Democratic Party's Stronghold of South Jeolla... The Cho Kuk Party Eyes Gaps in Damyang and Mokpo (민주당 텃밭 전남… 조국당, 담양·목포서 틈새 노린다)
item.description:
The Democratic Party's Stronghold of South Jeolla... The Cho Kuk Party Eyes Gaps in Damyang and Mokpo (민주당 텃밭 전남… 조국당, 담양·목포서 틈새 노린다)

Ahead of the June 3 local elections, the Cho Kuk Innovation Party has fielded candidates in 22 (as of the 22nd) of the 41 basic local government head constituencies in the Honam region. The most notable areas are Damyang and Mokpo in South Jeolla, along with Yeosu. Election experts say, "There is interest in how many elected officials the Cho Kuk Innovation Party can produce in Honam, where the Democratic Party is dominant." (6·3지방선거를 앞두고 조국혁신당은 호남 지역 기초단체장 선거구 41곳 중 22곳(22일 기준)에 후보를 냈다. 가장 눈에 띄는 곳은 전남 담양과 목포, 여수 등 세 곳이다. 선거 전문가들은 “더불어민주당이 우세한 호남에서 조국혁신당이 얼마나 당선자를 낼 수 있을지 관심”이라고 했다.)

In Damyang, incumbent County Governor Jeong Cheol-won is running under the Cho Kuk Innovation Party banner. Governor Jeong is the only incumbent local government head from the Cho Kuk Innovation Party. He will face off against Democratic Party Provincial Councilor Park Jong-won and independent candidate Choe Hwa-sam, former chairman of the Damyang County Council. (담양은 정철원 현 군수가 조국혁신당 소속으로 출마한다. 정 군수는 조국혁신당의 유일한 현직 단체장이다. 민주당 박종원 전남도의원, 무소속 최화삼 전 담양군의회 의장과 맞붙는다.)

Governor Jeong won the Damyang County by-election last April, defeating Democratic Party candidate Lee Jae-jong (48.17%) with 51.82% of the vote. This election was held after the Democratic Party's county governor was sentenced to invalidate his election for violating the Public Official Election Act. (정 군수는 작년 4월 담양군수 재·보궐선거에서 민주당 이재종 후보(48.17%)를 제치고 당선됐다. 득표율 51.82%를 기록했다. 이 선거는 민주당 소속 담양군수가 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 당선 무효형을 선고받아 치러졌다.)

According to a favorability survey commissioned by KBC Gwangju Broadcasting and Gwangnam Ilbo from Research View on February 2–3, Governor Jeong had 37.1% support, while Provincial Councilor Park had 23.3%. Party favorability was 66.9% for the Democratic Party and 18.4% for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, a gap of 48.5 percentage points. The survey targeted 500 Damyang county residents aged 18 and older. It was conducted via ARS automated voice calls using mobile virtual numbers. The response rate was 11.3%, with a margin of error of ±4.4 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission.) (KBC 광주방송·광남일보가 지난 2월 2~3일 리서치뷰에 의뢰해 실시한 지지도 조사 결과를 보면, 정 군수가 37.1%, 박 도의원이 23.3%였다. 정당 지지도는 민주당 66.9%, 조국혁신당 18.4%로 48.5%포인트 차이를 보였다. 이 조사는 만 18세 이상 담양군민 500명을 대상으로 했다. 휴대전화 가상 번호를 활용한 ARS 자동 응답 전화 조사 방식으로 진행했다. 응답률은 11.3%, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±4.4%포인트다.(중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 참조))

Provincial Councilor Park stated, "I will open the era of a trillion-won budget for Damyang County and become a county governor who prioritises Damyang's development." Governor Jeong said, "Based on the foundation laid over the past year, I will complete Damyang's future over the next four years." (박 도의원은 “담양군 예산 1조원 시대를 열어 담양 발전만 생각하는 군수가 되겠다”고 말했다. 정 군수는 “지난 1년간 다진 기반을 바탕으로 앞으로 4년간 담양의 미래를 완성하겠다”고 말했다.)

Public opinion in Damyang was divided. Mr. Choi (57) said, "After electing the Cho Kuk Innovation Party candidate as county governor, he did a good job," adding, "I plan to vote for Governor Jeong again this time." Mr. Jeong (55) said, "All other areas in South Jeolla will be swept by the Democratic Party, so if Damyang alone votes for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, we might be singled out, unable to secure budgets, and become isolated." (담양 민심은 엇갈렸다. 최모(57)씨는 “조국혁신당 후보도 군수로 뽑아보니 일 잘하더라”며 “이번에도 정 군수를 뽑을 생각”이라고 했다. 정모(55)씨는 “전남의 다른 지역은 죄다 민주당이 싹쓸이할 텐데 담양만 조국혁신당을 뽑으면 눈 밖에 나 예산도 못 받고 소외될 수 있다”고 했다.)

In the Mokpo mayoral election, Democratic Party Deputy Policy Committee Chair Kang Seong-hwi and former Mokpo Mayor Park Hong-ryul of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party will compete. Justice Party former Mokpo City Councilor Yeon In-doo and independent candidate Kim Si-yun, former head of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party's South Jeolla Provincial Party Youth Committee, have also entered the race. (목포시장 선거에선 민주당의 강성휘 당 정책위원회 부의장과 조국혁신당의 박홍률 전 목포시장이 대결한다. 정의당의 여인두 전 목포시의원과 무소속 김시윤 전 조국혁신당 전남도당 청년위원장도 도전장을 냈다.)

Deputy Chair Kang stated, "I will become a mayor who works rather than engages in politics," adding, "I will create a city where jobs increase and people return, a Mokpo that bounces back." Former Mayor Park said, "The current Democratic Party is caught up in the arrogance that ‘even a stick planted in Honam will get elected,’" vowing, "I will fight against Honam's monopoly on political power." (강 부의장은 “정치 대신 일하는 시장이 되겠다”며 “일자리가 늘고 사람이 돌아오는 도시, 다시 뛰는 목포를 만들겠다”고 말했다. 박 전 시장은 “지금 민주당은 ‘호남에는 막대기만 꽂아도 당선된다’는 오만에 빠져 있다”며 “호남의 독점적 정치 권력에 맞서 싸우겠다”고 말했다.)

Taxi driver Kim (54), met in front of Mokpo Station, said, "By also electing the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, the Democratic Party would pay more attention to Mokpo, wouldn’t it?" Mr. Jeong (62) said, "I used to vote based on character, not party, but these days, since President Lee Jae-myung is doing well, I lean more toward the Democratic Party." (목포역 앞에서 만난 택시 기사 김모(54)씨는 “조국혁신당도 뽑아줘야 민주당이 목포를 더 신경 쓸 것 아니냐”고 했다. 정모(62)씨는 “그동안 당 안 보고 인물 투표했는데 요즘에는 이재명 대통령이 잘하고 있어서 민주당에 더 손이 간다”고 했다.)

In the Yeosu mayoral election, while the Democratic Party is holding a primary, the Cho Kuk Innovation Party's Myeong Chang-hwan, former Deputy Governor of South Jeolla Province, has declared his candidacy. Yeosu is a place where independent mayors have been elected three times in past local elections. The Democratic Party will determine its mayoral candidate through a runoff between Kim Yeong-gyu, a six-term Yeosu city councilor, and Seo Yeong-hak, a former administrative officer in the Moon Jae-in presidential secretariat. (여수시장 선거에는 민주당이 후보 경선을 진행 중인 가운데 조국혁신당에선 명창환 전 전남도 행정부지사가 출마를 선언했다. 여수는 역대 지방선거에서 무소속 시장이 3번 당선된 곳이다. 민주당에선 김영규 여수시의원(6선)과 서영학 전 문재인 정부 대통령비서실 행정관이 결선 투표를 벌여 여수시장 후보를 결정한다.)

The South Jeolla region has long been considered a 'Democratic Party stronghold.' However, independent candidates have also won in several races each election. In the 2010 local elections, independent local government heads emerged in seven areas, including Yeosu and Suncheon. In 2014, there were eight independents; in 2018, five independents and three from the Party for People's Livelihoods won. (전남 지역은 ‘민주당 텃밭’으로 꼽혀왔다. 다만 선거 때마다 무소속 후보도 여럿 당선됐다. 2010년 지방선거 때는 여수, 순천 등 7곳에서 무소속 단체장이 나왔다. 2014년에는 무소속 8명, 2018년에는 무소속 5명, 민주평화당 소속 3명이 당선됐다.)

Election experts noted, "Many independent candidates were those who failed to be nominated in the Democratic Party's primary process and often returned to the Democratic Party after winning," adding, "This has led to a tendency to vote based on character rather than party affiliation." Oh Seung-yong, director of the polling agency Metavoice, explained, "Because being a Cho Kuk Innovation Party candidate allows them to get a ballot number 3, which is more advantageous than being an independent, many independent candidates have chosen the Cho Kuk Innovation Party this time." (선거 전문가들은 “무소속 후보 상당수가 민주당 공천 과정에서 탈락한 후보로 당선 후 민주당으로 복당하는 경우가 많았다”며 “이 때문에 소속보다 인물을 보고 투표하는 경향이 있다”고 했다. 여론조사 업체 메타보이스의 오승용 이사는 “조국혁신당 후보가 되면 무소속보다 앞선 기호 3번을 받을 수 있어 이번엔 조국혁신당을 선택한 무소속 후보가 많다”고 했다.)

There are predictions in the regional political scene that "with the alliance between the Democratic Party and the Cho Kuk Innovation Party broken, the outcome depends more on candidate competitiveness than party affiliation." (지역 정가에선 “민주당과 조국혁신당의 연대가 무산된 상황에서 당보다 인물 경쟁력에 달렸다”는 전망이 나온다.)

According to a public opinion survey commissioned by Newsis Gwangju-Jeonnam Headquarters, Mudeung Ilbo, and Gwangju MBC from Korea Research International on the 6th and 7th, targeting 1,001 men and women aged 18 and older living in Gwangju and South Jeolla, 79% of respondents supported the Democratic Party. The Cho Kuk Innovation Party received 5%, and the People Power Party 3%. The survey was conducted via phone interviews using mobile phone safety numbers. The response rate was 19.0%, with a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission.) (뉴시스 광주전남본부와 무등일보, 광주MBC가 코리아리서치인터내셔널에 의뢰해 지난 6~7일 광주·전남에 사는 18세 이상 남녀 1001명을 대상으로 실시한 여론조사 결과를 보면, 응답자 79%가 민주당을 지지하는 것으로 나타났다. 조국혁신당은 5%, 국민의힘은 3%였다. 이 조사는 휴대전화 안심 번호를 이용해 전화 면접 방식으로 진행했다. 응답률은 19.0%, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±3.1%포인트다.(중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 참조))

Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, who declared his candidacy for the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election for the National Assembly, is touring the Honam region to support his party's candidates. Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae held a Supreme Council meeting at the Damyang Agricultural Cooperative on the 10th, stating, "I will also ensure that key budgets for Damyang are well managed at the central party level." (경기 평택을 국회의원 재·보궐선거 출마를 선언한 조국 조국혁신당 대표는 호남 지역을 다니며 후보들을 지원하고 있다. 정청래 민주당 대표는 지난 10일 담양농협에서 최고위원 회의를 열고 “담양의 핵심 예산도 중앙당 차원에서 잘 챙기겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Wando Becomes a Political Vacuum… Woo Hong-seop’s “Sea Pension” vs. Kim Shin’s “Abalone Industry Innovation” (무주공산 된 완도… 우홍섭 “바다 연금” vs 김신 “전복 산업 혁신”)
item.description:
Wando Becomes a Political Vacuum… Woo Hong-seop’s “Sea Pension” vs. Kim Shin’s “Abalone Industry Innovation” (무주공산 된 완도… 우홍섭 “바다 연금” vs 김신 “전복 산업 혁신” )

The June 3 election for Wando County Governor in South Jeolla Province is shaping up as a two-way race between Woo Hong-seop (60), the deputy chair of the Democratic Party of Korea’s South Jeolla Provincial Committee, and independent Kim Shin (63), a former member of the Wando County Council. (6·3 전남 완도군수 선거는 우홍섭(60) 더불어민주당 전남도당 부위원장과 무소속 김신(63) 전 완도군의원의 2파전으로 치러진다.)

Deputy Chair Woo has served as the deputy county governor of Jindo and as head of the South Jeolla Province Social Welfare Division. He has proposed a “sea pension” policy, which involves promoting renewable energy projects such as wind and solar power to distribute profits to residents. He stated, “By leveraging Wando’s abundant offshore wind power and seaweed resources, I will establish a profit-sharing system on par with (the solar pension introduced in) Shinan County.” He also pledged to implement a “minimum price guarantee for abalone” to protect local fishermen. (우 부위원장은 진도 부군수와 전남도 사회복지과장 등을 지냈다. 풍력이나 태양광 등 재생에너지 사업을 추진해 주민들에게 수익을 나눠주는 ‘바다연금’을 공약으로 내세웠다. 그는 “완도의 풍부한 해상풍력과 해조류 자원을 활용해 (햇빛연금을 도입한) 신안군 못지않은 수익 공유 시스템을 구축하겠다”고 했다. 또 완도 어민들을 보호하기 위해 ‘전복 최저가 보장제’를 시행하겠다고 했다.)

Former Councilor Kim is a two-term member of the Wando County Council. This marks his fourth bid for county governor since 2014. He left the Democratic Party during its candidate nomination process in February. Kim has prioritized innovation in the abalone and seaweed industries. This is because Wando’s core industries—abalone and seaweed farming—are in crisis due to overproduction and price declines. Wando accounts for 70% of the nation’s abalone production. He stated, “I will address the chronic problem of inadequate medical infrastructure on the islands and significantly expand the mobility rights of island residents.” (김 전 군의원은 완도군의회 재선 의원 출신이다. 2014년 이후 네 번째 완도군수 선거에 도전한다. 지난 2월 민주당 공천 과정에서 탈당했다. 김 전 군의원은 전복·해조류 산업의 혁신을 최우선 과제로 꼽았다. 완도의 핵심 산업인 전복·해조류 산업이 과잉 생산, 가격 하락 등으로 위기에 빠져 있기 때문이다. 완도는 전국 전복 생산량의 70%를 차지한다. 그는 “섬 지역의 고질적 문제인 의료 인프라 부실 문제를 해결하고 섬 주민의 이동권도 대폭 확보할 것”이라고 했다.)

Since the launch of local elections in 1995, Wando has had only three elected county governors over 31 years, all of whom served two or three terms. The current governor, Shin Woo-cheol, is serving his third term and cannot run in this election due to term limit regulations. (완도는 1995년 지방선거가 시작된 이후 31년간 당선된 군수가 3명이다. 3명 모두 재선이나 3선을 했기 때문이다. 신우철 현 군수도 3선 군수다. ‘연임 제한’ 규정에 따라 이번 선거에 출마하지 못한다.)

In the Democratic Party’s primary, as many as nine preliminary candidates competed. (이번 민주당 경선에는 예비후보만 9명이 몰렸다.)

Local public opinion is divided. A resident of Wando-eup, Kim (52), said, “Given the difficult local economy, I think we need an administrative expert like Deputy Chair Woo and support from the ruling party.” Another resident, Park (60), remarked, “Even though he lost three times in previous Wando County Governor elections, I plan to vote for former Councilor Kim, who has quietly lived alongside the residents all along.” (지역 여론은 팽팽하다. 완도읍에 사는 김모(52)씨는 “지역 경제가 어려운 상황에선 우 부위원장 같은 행정 전문가와 여당의 지원이 필요하다고 생각한다”고 했다. 박모(60)씨는 “그동안 완도군수 선거에서 세 번 낙선했어도 묵묵하게 주민들과 동거동락한 김 전 군의원을 뽑을 생각”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Ulsan Buk-gu, Home to Hyundai Motor, Sees Third Showdown Between Former and Current District Heads (현대차 있는 울산 북구, 전·현직 구청장 세번째 맞대결)
item.description:
Ulsan Buk-gu, Home to Hyundai Motor, Sees Third Showdown Between Former and Current District Heads (현대차 있는 울산 북구, 전·현직 구청장 세번째 맞대결)

In the June 3 election for Ulsan Buk-gu District Head, former and current district chiefs are facing off for the third time. They are Lee Dong-kwon (69), former district head from the Democratic Party of Korea, and Park Cheon-dong (60), the current district head from the People Power Party. Lee, representing the Democratic Party, is vowing to "retake the high ground," while Park, from the People Power Party, is leveraging his incumbency advantage to defend his position. Lee Eun-young (60), a former Ulsan city councilor from the Progressive Party, also declared her candidacy in January. (6·3 울산 북구청장 선거에서는 전현직 구청장이 세 번째 대결을 펼친다. 더불어민주당 소속의 이동권(69) 전 구청장과 국민의힘 박천동(60) 현 구청장이다. 민주당에서는 이 전 청장이 “고지를 탈환하겠다”며 벼르고 있고, 국민의힘 박 청장은 현역 프리미엄을 앞세워 수성에 나섰다. 진보당 이은영(60) 전 울산시의원도 지난 1월 출마를 선언했다.)

In the 2018 local elections, former district head Lee won with 45.55% of the vote, defeating then-incumbent Park of the Liberty Korea Party (32.54%) by a margin of 13.01 percentage points. In the 2022 local elections, Park secured 50.60% of the vote, surpassing incumbent Lee (40.02%). If Park wins this election, he will become the first three-term Buk-gu District Head. (2018년 지방선거에서는 이 전 구청장이 45.55%를 얻어 당시 재선을 노리던 자유한국당 소속 박 구청장(32.54%)을 13.01%포인트 차로 이겼다. 2022년 지방선거에서는 박 구청장이 50.60%를 얻어 현직이던 이 전 구청장(40.02%)을 눌렀다. 이번 선거에서 박 구청장이 승리하면 첫 3선 북구청장이 된다.)

Ulsan Buk-gu has an average age of 41.3, making it the youngest district in Ulsan. It is also home to Hyundai Motor's Ulsan plant, its partner companies, and small-to-medium-sized enterprises, and is considered a region with a high concentration of progressive-leaning voters. In the 21st presidential election, Democratic Party candidate Lee Jae-myung won 48.63% of the vote here, defeating People Power Party candidate Kim Moon-soo, who got 40.63%, by an 8-percentage-point margin. Even in the 20th presidential election, when former President Yoon Suk-yeol was elected, Ulsan Buk-gu was the only place in the Yeongnam region where Lee Jae-myung outperformed Yoon. (울산 북구는 평균 연령이 41.3세로 울산에서 가장 젊은 구다. 또 현대자동차 울산 공장과 협력업체, 중소기업이 밀집해 진보 성향 유권자가 많은 지역으로 꼽힌다. 21대 대선 때는 민주당 이재명 후보가 48.63%를 얻어 국민의힘 김문수 후보 40.63%를 8%포인트 차로 이겼다. 윤석열 전 대통령이 당선된 20대 대선 때도 영남권에서 유일하게 이재명 후보가 윤 대통령을 이긴 곳이 울산 북구다.)

In Ulsan Buk-gu, no single party has consecutively held the district head position in past elections. During the second local election cycle, independent Jo Seung-su was elected district head; in the third cycle, Lee Sang-beom of the Democratic Labor Party; in the fourth, Kang Seok-gu of the Grand National Party; in the fifth, Yoon Jong-oh of the Democratic Labor Party; in the sixth, Park Cheon-dong of the Saenuri Party; in the seventh, Lee Dong-kwon of the Democratic Party; and in the eighth, Park Cheon-dong of the People Power Party. (울산 북구는 역대 구청장 선거에서 한 정당이 연속으로 구청장을 배출한 적이 없다. 민선 2기엔 무소속 조승수 구청장이 당선됐고 3기 민주노동당 이상범, 4기 한나라당 강석구, 5기 민주노동당 윤종오, 6기 새누리당 박천동, 7기 민주당 이동권, 8기엔 국민의힘 박천동 구청장이 당선됐다.)

Election experts are watching whether a candidate unification between the Democratic Party and the Progressive Party will occur. Both parties agree on the need for unification. However, the situation has become complicated as the Progressive Party has fielded candidates for all positions in Ulsan—including the mayoral race and the heads of five district and county governments. The Progressive Party insists that "unification discussions should cover not only district heads but also metropolitan councilors," while the Democratic Party maintains that "unification should be limited to district head elections, and unification for metropolitan councilors will be handled as needed." Professor Do Soo-gwan of the Department of Public Administration at the University of Ulsan noted, "The current government's approval ratings could work in the Democratic Party's favor," but added, "If progressive candidates fail to unify, a structure favoring the incumbent district head could emerge." (선거 전문가들은 민주당과 진보당의 후보 단일화가 이뤄질지 주목한다. 민주당과 진보당은 단일화의 필요성에 공감하고 있다. 다만 진보당이 울산시장과 울산 지역 5개 구·군 기초단체장 선거에 모두 후보를 내면서 단일화 셈법이 복잡해졌다. 진보당은 “단체장은 물론 광역의원까지 포함해 후보 단일화를 논의해야 한다”는 입장인 반면, 민주당은 “단체장 선거 정도까지 단일화를 하고 광역의원 후보 단일화는 필요에 따라 하겠다”는 입장이다. 도수관 울산대 행정학과 교수는 “현 정부 지지율이 민주당에 유리하게 작용할 수 있다”면서도 “진보 진영 후보 간 단일화가 이뤄지지 않을 경우 현역 구청장에게 유리한 구도가 형성될 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: ‘Original Pro-Lee’ Kim Byung-wook vs Incumbent Mayor Shin Sang-jin… A Tight Race Within the Margin of Error (‘원조 친명’ 김병욱 vs 現 시장 신상진… 오차 범위 접전)
item.description:
‘Original Pro-Lee’ Kim Byung-wook vs Incumbent Mayor Shin Sang-jin… A Tight Race Within the Margin of Error (‘원조 친명’ 김병욱 vs 現 시장 신상진… 오차 범위 접전)

Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, with a population of 900,000, is where President Lee Jae-myung served as mayor from 2010 to 2018. In the upcoming June 3 Seongnam mayoral election, former Democratic Party presidential secretary for political affairs Kim Byung-wook (age 61) and incumbent People Power Party Mayor Shin Sang-jin (age 70) will face off. The Progressive Party is fielding co-leader Jang Ji-hwa (age 56), while Liberty and Innovation has dentist Cho Jun-hyun (age 58) as its candidate. (인구 90만명인 경기 성남은 이재명 대통령이 2010~2018년 시장을 한 곳이다. 이번 6·3 성남시장 선거에는 더불어민주당 김병욱(61) 전 대통령 정무비서관과 국민의힘 신상진(70) 현 시장이 대결한다. 진보당에선 장지화(56) 진보당 공동대표가, 자유와혁신에서는 치과의사 조준현(58)씨가 출마한다.)

Former Secretary Kim graduated from Hanyang University’s College of Law and majored in financial economics at Korea University’s Business School. He is a former “securities man” who worked at Ssangyong Securities. He began his full-fledged political career in 2010 as the head of the Democratic Party’s district committee for Seongnam’s Bundang-gu district (constituency B). When President Lee served as Seongnam mayor, Kim acted as co-chair of the Seongnam Policy Forum and as a director of the Seongnam Industrial Promotion Agency. He won elections in the 2016 and 2020 general elections in Bundang-gu (constituency B), a strong conservative stronghold. This is his first mayoral bid. He is a member of the “Group of Seven,” a core group of pro-Lee figures, and served as President Lee’s first presidential secretary for political affairs. Locally, former Secretary Kim is often referred to as “Lee Jae-myung’s man.” (김 전 비서관은 한양대 법대를 졸업하고, 고려대 경영대학원에서 금융경제학을 전공했다. 쌍용증권에서 일한 ‘증권맨’ 출신이다. 2010년 민주당 성남 분당구을 지역위원장을 맡아 본격적으로 정치 활동을 시작했다. 이 대통령이 성남시장을 할 때 성남정책포럼 공동대표, 성남산업진흥재단 이사 등으로 활동했다. 2016년, 2020년 총선 때 ‘보수세’가 강한 분당을 선거구에서 당선됐다. 시장 출마는 처음이다. 친명계 핵심 인사들로 불리는 ‘7인회’ 멤버다. 이재명 정부의 첫 대통령 정무비서관을 맡았다. 지역에선 김 전 비서관을 두고 ‘이재명의 남자’라는 말이 나온다.)

Mayor Shin, a physician-turned-politician, graduated from Seoul National University’s College of Medicine. In 1982, he was arrested for violating the National Security Act, Anti-Communism Act, and Martial Law Act while engaged in student activism. He later worked at Dongyang Special Machinery in Seongnam’s Sangdaewon Industrial Complex, doing labor activism during the day and teaching at a night school. He opened “Seongnam Clinic” in Sangdaewon Market and worked as both a doctor and civic activist. It is said he developed a close relationship with President Lee, who was then a lawyer in Seongnam. In the 2005 by-election for the National Assembly, he ran in Seongnam’s Jungwon-gu district and won, subsequently serving four consecutive terms. He was elected Seongnam mayor in the 2022 local elections. (신 시장은 서울대 의대를 졸업한 의사 출신 정치인이다. 1982년 학생 운동을 하다 국가보안법·반공법·계엄법 위반 혐의로 구속됐다. 이후 성남 상대원공단에 있는 동양특수기공에 취업해 낮에는 노동운동을 하고 밤에는 야학 교사를 했다. 상대원시장에 ‘성남의원’을 열고 의사 겸 시민운동가로 활동했다. 당시 성남에서 변호사로 활동하던 이 대통령과도 가깝게 지냈다고 한다. 2005년 국회의원 재선거에서 성남중원구에 출마해 당선된 이후 내리 4선을 했다. 2022년 선거 때 성남시장에 당선됐다.)

Former Secretary Kim stated, “The next four years will see the terms of President Lee and the next Seongnam mayor perfectly align,” calling it “a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to change Seongnam.” He added, “A ‘one team’ combining full central government support and strong local government drive can lead Seongnam’s great leap forward.” In contrast, Mayor Shin said, “Over the past four years, I have focused on restoring trust in Seongnam’s finances and administration,” vowing, “I will steadfastly push ahead with policies that citizens can feel, such as redevelopment and reconstruction, setting aside political logic.” (김 전 비서관은 “앞으로 4년은 이 대통령과 차기 성남시장의 임기가 온전히 일치한다”며 “성남을 바꿀 수 있는 천재일우의 기회”라고 했다. 그는 “중앙정부의 전폭적인 지원과 지방정부의 강력한 추진력이 결합된 원팀이 성남의 대도약을 이끌 수 있다”고 했다. 반면 신 시장은 “지난 4년간 성남시 재정과 행정에 대한 신뢰를 정상화하는데 집중했다”며 “정치 논리를 떠나 재개발·재건축 등 시민이 체감할 수 있는 정책을 흔들림 없이 이어가겠다”고 했다.)

In Seongnam’s eight mayoral elections, Democratic Party-affiliated candidates have won four times, People Power Party-affiliated candidates three times, and an independent candidate once. (성남은 8번의 시장 선거에서 민주당 계열 후보가 4번, 국민의힘 계열 후보가 3번, 무소속 후보가 1번 당선됐다.)

The atmosphere also differs between the old downtown areas like Jungwon-gu and Sujeong-gu and the new city of Bundang-gu. Looking at Seongnam’s National Assembly districts, Jungwon-gu and Sujeong-gu are represented by the Democratic Party, while Bundang-gu (constituencies A and B) are represented by the People Power Party. In last year’s presidential election, President Lee won in Jungwon-gu and Sujeong-gu, but People Power Party candidate Kim Moon-soo won in Bundang-gu. (중원·수정구 등 구도심과 분당구 등 신도시의 분위기도 다르다. 성남 지역 국회의원을 보면 중원·수정 선거구는 민주당, 분당 갑·을 선거구는 국민의힘 소속이다. 작년 대선 때 중원·수정구에선 이 대통령이 승리했지만 분당구에선 국민의힘 김문수 후보가 이겼다.)

Election experts note, “This election pits a Democratic Party candidate who served as a National Assembly member in Bundang-gu against a People Power Party candidate who served as a lawmaker in Jungwon-gu,” adding, “It will be interesting to see if past voting patterns shift.” (선거 전문가들은 “이번 선거는 분당구에서 국회의원을 한 민주당 후보와 중원구에서 국회의원을 한 국민의힘 후보가 맞붙는 상황”이라며 “종전 투표 경향이 바뀔지 관심”이라고 했다.)

According to recent opinion polls, former Secretary Kim and Mayor Shin are locked in a race within the margin of error. A Seongnam mayoral suitability poll conducted by the Korea Public Opinion Rating Institute from the 11th to the 13th (commissioned by Insa-it Gyeonggi), targeting 501 Seongnam citizens aged 18 and older (using wireless virtual numbers and wired RDD via ARS), showed former Secretary Kim at 34.0% and Mayor Shin at 33.0%. Party support was 46% for the Democratic Party and 27% for the People Power Party. (The margin of error is ±4.4 percentage points at a 95% confidence level; refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission.) (최근 여론조사 결과를 보면 김 전 비서관과 신 시장이 오차 범위 내에서 경합하고 있다. 인싸잇경기 의뢰로 한국여론평판연구소가 지난 11~13일 만 18세 이상 성남시민 501명을 대상으로 실시한 ‘성남시장 적합도’ 여론조사(무선 가상번호와 유선 RDD를 이용한 ARS 조사)에 따르면, 김 전 비서관은 34.0%, 신 시장은 33.0%였다. 정당 지지도는 민주당이 46%, 국민의힘이 27%였다.(표본오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±4.4%포인트, 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 참조))

Professor Park Chang-hwan of Jang-an University, a special appointment professor, said, “The key is how strongly supporters will rally,” adding, “We might not know the outcome until election day.” (박창환 장안대 특임교수는 “지지자들이 얼마나 결집할지가 관건”이라며 “개표 날까지 가봐야 결과를 알 수 있을 것 같다”고 했다.)

Opinions among citizens met on the ground were also diverse. Mr. Kim (age 34), met at Pangyo Station on the Shinbundang Line in Bundang-gu, said, “Seongnam is a city that produced a president,” adding, “Regardless of party, I plan to vote for a mayor who gets things done.” Mr. Park (age 46), a resident of an apartment in Sunae-dong, Bundang-gu, said, “It’s not a given that people will vote Democratic just because President Lee was Seongnam mayor.” Yoo Jin-sook (age 56), a housewife living in Sangdaewon 1-dong, Jungwon-gu, said, “Seongnam has had its share of controversies, like Daejang-dong and Baekhyeon-dong,” adding, “I hope someone who won’t stir up noise becomes mayor.” (현장에서 만난 시민들의 의견도 다양했다. 분당구 신분당선 판교역에서 만난 김모(34)씨는 “성남은 대통령을 배출한 도시”라며 “정당을 떠나 일 잘하는 시장을 뽑을 생각”이라고 했다. 분당구 수내동 아파트에 사는 박모(46)씨는 “이 대통령이 성남시장을 했다고 해서 무조건 민주당을 찍는 분위기는 아니다”라고 했다. 중원구 상대원1동에 사는 주부 유진숙(56)씨는 “성남이 그동안 대장동이다, 백현동이다 말도 많고 탈도 많았다”며 “시끄러운 소리 안 나오는 사람이 시장이 되면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil Nominated for Yeonsu Gap, Kim Nam-jun for Gyeyang-eul (與 연수갑 송영길·계양을 김남준 공천)
item.description:
Song Young-gil Nominated for Yeonsu Gap, Kim Nam-jun for Gyeyang-eul (與 연수갑 송영길·계양을 김남준 공천)

The Democratic Party of Korea has strategically nominated former party leader Song Young-gil and Kim Nam-jun, a former senior presidential secretary and close aide to President Lee Jae-myung, for the by-elections in Incheon's Yeonsu Gap and Gyeyang-eul districts, respectively, which will be held concurrently with the June 3 local elections. (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거와 동시에 치러지는 인천 연수갑·계양을 국회의원 재·보궐선거에 각각 송영길 전 대표와 이재명 대통령 최측근인 김남준 전 청와대 대변인을 전략공천했다.)

Former Incheon Mayor Song, who was acquitted of charges related to the "party convention cash envelopes" scandal, had initially sought to run in Gyeyang-eul—a district where he served five terms as a lawmaker before handing it over to President Lee—but ended up being assigned to Yeonsu Gap, a more conservative-leaning area. Yeonsu Gap is the current district of three-term lawmaker Park Chan-dae, who secured the Democratic Party's nomination for the Incheon mayoral race, triggering the by-election. The party explained, "Yeonsu Gap is a challenging area for the Democratic Party and a key strategic stronghold we must defend. Considering Song's political weight, we have deployed him as a strategic move." <<> Gyeyang-eul, a Democratic Party stronghold, was President Lee's constituency during his time as a lawmaker. In this district, Kim Nam-jun, who served as President Lee's close aide since his days as Seongnam mayor, is now seeking to enter the National Assembly. Known as "Lee Jae-myung's voice," Kim is a key confidant. President Lee's famous remark, "If you want to know my thoughts, ask Kim Nam-jun," underscores their close relationship. A former cable TV reporter in Seongnam, Kim served as spokesperson during Lee's terms as Seongnam mayor and Gyeonggi governor, and later as senior secretary and spokesperson at the presidential office after the Lee administration took power. He resigned as spokesperson in February to run in Gyeyang-eul. Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun praised him, stating, "Kim has a deep understanding of President Lee's governance philosophy and, having assisted him during his time as a lawmaker, possesses a high level of familiarity with the Gyeyang-eul district." (인천시장 출신의 송 전 대표는 ‘전당대회 돈 봉투’ 사건 관련 무죄 확정 후 자신이 5선 국회의원을 지냈다가 이 대통령에게 넘겨준 계양을 출마를 원했지만 상대적으로 보수 세가 강한 연수갑에 출마하게 됐다. 연수갑은 3선 박찬대 의원의 지역구로 박 의원이 민주당 인천시장 후보로 선출되면서 보선이 치러지게 됐다. 민주당은 “연수갑은 민주당에 녹록지 않은 지역이자 반드시 사수해야 할 핵심 전략지역”이라며 “송 전 대표의 중량감을 고려해 전략적으로 배치했다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Joo Ho-young Declares He Will Not Run for Daegu Mayor (주호영, 대구시장 불출마 선언)
item.description:
Joo Ho-young Declares He Will Not Run for Daegu Mayor (주호영, 대구시장 불출마 선언)

Joo Ho-young (six-term lawmaker, Daegu Suseong-gap), who was cut off (excluded from the primary) in the People Power Party's Daegu mayoral primary, declared on the 23rd that he would not run for Daegu mayor. Joo had been weighing whether to run as an independent. (국민의힘 대구시장 경선에서 컷오프(경선 배제)됐던 주호영(6선·대구 수성갑) 의원이 23일 대구시장 불출마를 선언했다. 주 의원은 그간 무소속 출마 여부를 저울질해 왔다.)

On the 22nd of last month, the People Power Party cut off both Joo and former Korea Communications Commission Chairperson Lee Jin-sook from the Daegu mayoral primary. In response, Joo filed an injunction to suspend the decision with the court. After the Seoul Southern District Court dismissed the request, Joo appealed, and the Seoul High Court rejected the appeal on the 22nd. (국민의힘은 지난달 22일 대구시장 경선에서 주 의원과 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장을 컷오프했다. 주 의원은 이에 반발해 법원에 효력 정지 가처분을 신청했다. 서울남부지법이 신청을 기각하자 주 의원은 항고했고, 서울고법은 지난 22일 항고를 기각했다.)

At a press conference at the National Assembly on the same day, Joo criticized the People Power Party leadership for the cutoff decision but stated, "I judged that continued disputes over my candidacy could further disrupt the election." He added, "I decided to clearly settle my position and believe it is right to take greater responsibility in the future for correcting the party's nomination structure and rebuilding conservatism." (주 의원은 이날 국회 기자회견을 열고 컷오프를 결정한 국민의힘 지도부를 비판하면서도 “제 출마 여부를 둘러싼 공방이 더 이어질수록 선거를 더 꼬이게 할 수 있다는 판단을 했다”고 했다. 그러면서 “제 입장을 분명히 정리하고, 앞으로는 당의 공천 구조를 바로잡고 보수를 다시 세우는 일에 더 무겁게 책임을 지는 것이 옳다고 판단했다”고 했다.)

Lee Jin-sook, the former Korea Communications Commission chairperson who was also cut off alongside Joo, is still keeping the possibility of an independent run open. In a News1 interview on the 21st, Lee said, "Even in a three-way race, I still believe that those disappointed and angered by the unfair and unjust cutoff will give me their votes." However, Lee added, "The most ideal scenario is indeed that there is a unified right-wing candidate to face candidate Kim Boo-kyum, which gives the best chance of winning." (주 의원과 함께 컷오프된 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장은 무소속 출마 가능성을 아직 열어놓은 상황이다. 이 전 위원장은 21일 뉴스1 인터뷰에서 “3자 구도가 되더라도 부당하고 불공정한 컷오프에 실망하고 분노하신 분들이 저에게 표를 주실 것이라 믿고 있는 부분은 여전히 있다”고 했다. 다만 이 전 위원장은 “가장 이상적인 시나리오는 김부겸 후보에 대해서 맞서는 우파 단일 후보가 있는 게 가장 승산이 큰 것은 사실”이라고 했다.)

The People Power Party leadership, including leader Jang Dong-hyuk, reportedly met with Lee earlier this month to persuade her to run for a by-election for a National Assembly seat, but Lee did not give a definitive answer. It is known that local figures in Daegu have been continuing efforts to persuade her until recently. (장동혁 대표 등 국민의힘 지도부는 이달 초 이 전 위원장을 만나 국회의원 재·보궐 선거를 설득했지만 이 전 위원장이 확답을 하지 않았다고 한다. 최근까지도 대구 지역 인사들이 설득 중인 것으로 알려졌다.)

Lawmakers Choo Kyung-ho and Yoo Young-ha, who are competing in the primary for the People Power Party candidacy, have stated their position that "there will be no unification with independent candidates." The final candidate for the People Power Party will be selected on the 26th. An opposition figure commented, "If it becomes a three-way race among the Democratic Party's Kim Boo-kyum, the People Power Party's final candidate, and independent Lee Jin-sook, a split in conservative votes could result in Daegu being lost to the Democratic Party for the first time." A People Power Party official said, "With Joo Ho-young not running, it seems the support base's sentiment will consolidate around the People Power Party candidate." <<> Meanwhile, Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Daegu mayor, held a press conference in Daegu on the same day and announced that "the Democratic Party has already concluded consultations to accelerate the construction of the Daegu-Gyeongbuk New Airport, which involves a total project cost of 15 trillion won," stating that 1 trillion won has been secured, including 500 billion won from the Public Fund Management Fund and an additional 500 billion won in special government support. He also expressed his intention to revive the abandoned Daegu-Gyeongbuk administrative integration. (국민의힘 후보를 두고 경선 중인 추경호·유영하 의원은 “무소속 출마자와 단일화는 없다”는 입장을 밝힌 상황이다. 국민의힘 최종 후보는 26일 선출된다. 야권 관계자는 “만약 민주당 김부겸 후보와 국민의힘 최종 후보, 무소속 이진숙 후보 3파전이 된다면, 보수 표심 분열로 대구를 최초로 민주당에 뺏길 수도 있다”고 했다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “주호영 의원이 불출마한 상황에서 지지층 표심이 국민의힘 후보로 결집하게 될 것 같다”고 했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Candidates Emphasize 'One Team' at Joint Assembly in National Assembly (민주당 후보들은 ‘원팀’ 강조하면서 국회서 연석회의)
item.description:
Democratic Party Candidates Emphasize 'One Team' at Joint Assembly in National Assembly (민주당 후보들은 ‘원팀’ 강조하면서 국회서 연석회의)

The Democratic Party of Korea's metropolitan and provincial governor candidates gathered for the first time at the National Assembly on the 23rd, chanting for victory in the June 3 local elections. Party leader Chung Cheong-rae emphasized the 'one team' spirit, stating, "We were born on this land with a historical mission to achieve victory in the June 3 local elections and the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. The party will mobilize all its capabilities to support your victory." (더불어민주당 시·도지사 후보들이 23일 국회에서 처음으로 한자리에 모여 6·3 지방선거 승리를 외쳤다. 정청래 대표는 ‘원팀’을 강조하며 “우리는 6·3 지방선거 승리와 이재명 정부의 성공에 역사적 사명을 띠고 이 땅에 태어났다. 당은 모든 역량을 총동원해 여러분의 승리를 뒷받침하겠다”고 했다.)

Chung made these remarks while presiding over a joint meeting of candidates for 16 metropolitan council heads, adding, "We have carried out the most democratic, fastest, and fairest nomination process, free from corruption and irregularities. Only by winning the June 3 local elections can the Lee Jae-myung administration succeed." Daegu mayoral candidate Kim Boo-kyum and South Gyeongsang Province governor candidate Kim Kyoung-soo were absent due to regional schedules, with Heo So, the Daegu party chair, and Heo Seong-moo, the South Gyeongsang party chair, attending in their place. The two absent candidates sent video messages. (정 대표는 이날 16개 광역단체장 후보 연석회의를 열고 이같이 말하며 “가장 민주적이고, 가장 빠르고, 가장 공정한, 부정·비리 없는 공천을 했다. 6·3 지방선거를 승리해야 이재명 정부가 성공할 수 있다”고 했다. 이날 김부겸 대구시장 후보, 김경수 경남지사 후보는 지역 일정 등을 이유로 불참했고, 대신 허소 대구시당위원장과 허성무 경남도당위원장이 참석했다. 두 후보는 영상 메시지를 보냈다.)

The candidates performed a symbolic act by attaching blue puzzle pieces to their respective campaign regions on a map of South Korea, filling the entire country with blue. The completed map bore the slogan 'Capable Local Government.' Party leader Chung Cheong-rae placed a panel reading 'Normalization of the Republic of Korea' on the map and raised his fist, shouting, "Fighting, Democratic Party of Korea!" At this event, Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh declared, "Seoul will lead the way in changing the landscape of local elections," while Ulsan mayoral candidate Kim Sang-wook shouted, "Blow, southeast wind!" (후보들은 우리나라 지도에 나와 있는 각자의 출마지에 파란색 퍼즐을 차례로 붙이며, 전국을 모두 파란색으로 채우는 퍼포먼스를 선보였다. 완성된 지도에는 슬로건인 ‘일 잘하는 지방정부’가 새겨졌다. 정청래 대표는 ‘대한민국 국가 정상화’라는 문구가 적힌 패널을 지도 위에 붙인 뒤 주먹을 번쩍 들며 “더불어민주당 화이팅!”을 외쳤다. 이 자리에서 정원오 서울시장 후보는 “지방선거 실력 교체, 서울이 앞장서겠다”고 했고 김상욱 울산시장 후보는 “불어라 동남풍!”이라고 했다.)

The party leadership recently visited all 16 metropolitan cities and provinces to support candidates. This week, they traveled to Boryeong in South Chungcheong and Tongyeong in South Gyeongsang. Starting on the 24th, they will visit Incheon, Mokpo in South Jeolla, and Daegu. Going forward, they plan to hold field supreme council meetings two to three times a week until election day. (최근 민주당 지도부는 후보 지원을 위해 16개 시도를 전부 방문했다. 이번 주 충남 보령, 경남 통영을 다녀왔고 24일부터는 인천, 전남 목포, 대구 등을 방문한다. 앞으로도 선거일까지 주 2~3회씩 현장 최고위원회의를 열 계획이다.)

The Democratic Party is also releasing weekly life-oriented public welfare pledges. On this day, they unveiled pledges 10, 11, and 12 under the 'Perfect Fit Pledges' initiative, including measures to allow the restoration of savings and installment accounts canceled by mistake. The party is also forming a united front among candidates to announce joint pledges. (민주당은 생활 밀착형 민생 공약도 매주 내고 있다. 이날은 ‘착!붙 공약’ 10·11·12호도 공개했다. 실수로 해약한 예·적금의 원상복구를 가능하게 하는 내용 등이다. 민주당은 후보들 간 연합 전선도 꾸려 공통 공약을 발표하고 있다.)

item.title: “The risk of Jang is now greater than the risk of martial law.” (“張 리스크가 계엄 리스크보다 커졌다”)
item.description:
“The risk of Jang is now greater than the risk of martial law.” (“張 리스크가 계엄 리스크보다 커졌다”)

When People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 23rd, “Any candidate who engages in such acts will be promptly replaced,” the party’s candidate election camps reacted with defiance. Some metropolitan government heads have already begun distancing themselves from Jang’s leadership, forming independent election campaign committees and adopting a go-it-alone strategy. In various regions, voices are saying, “Please, just having Representative Jang stay quiet is the only way to help the election.” (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 23일 “해당 행위를 한 후보는 즉시 교체하겠다”고 하자, 국민의힘의 후보 선거 캠프들이 반발하고 있다. 이미 일부 광역단체장 후보들은 장동혁 지도부와 거리를 두며 독자 선거대책위원회를 꾸리는 등 각개전투에 돌입한 가운데, 각 지역에선 “제발 장 대표가 가만히 있어주는 게 선거를 도와주는 유일한 길”이라는 말이 나온다.)

With the June 3 local elections just 40 days away and the party’s approval rating hitting an all-time low since its founding, candidates’ camps are seeing an explosion of discontent, compounded by Jang’s remarks. A source from a metropolitan government candidate’s camp said, “Public opinion was already shaken when the ruling party obstinately pushed for a parliamentary investigation into ‘fabricated indictments’ to force the withdrawal of the indictment in President Lee Jae-myung’s case, while also making unreasonable claims. Now, Jang’s comments about candidate replacements following his U.S. visit are only intensifying internal conflict.” They added, “It’s hard to understand why Jang can’t read the room and insists on going his own way.” (각 지역 후보 캠프에선 6·3 지방선거가 40일 앞으로 다가운 가운데 당 지지율이 창당 이래 최저치를 찍은 상황에서 장 대표 발언까지 겹치면서 불만이 폭발하고 있다. 한 광역단체장 후보 측은 “여당이 막무가내로 이재명 대통령 사건의 공소 취소를 위해 ‘조작 기소’ 국정조사를 강행하고 억지 주장까지 펼치자 여론이 출렁였다”며 “그런데 장 대표의 방미에 이은 후보 교체 발언은 내분을 격화시키는 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “장 대표가 진짜 왜 분위기를 못 읽고 자기 고집대로 하는지 이해하기 어렵다”고 했다.)

A camp from the Yeongnam region remarked, “Every time the central party unleashes a bomb, we end up taking the hit. The risk of Jang Dong-hyuk as leader is greater than the risk of martial law.” Another camp from the same region added, “We have no choice but to rely on the personal capabilities of each candidate to move forward step by step.” Meanwhile, camps for metropolitan government heads in Seoul, TK (Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province), and PK (Busan and South Gyeongsang Province) are strategizing by either launching independent election committees or forming alliances with neighboring regions for their campaign committees. (한 영남권 캠프 측은 “중앙당이 한 번 폭탄을 쏟아낼 때마다 우리는 폭격을 맞는 격”이라며 “계엄 리스크보다 장동혁 대표 리스크가 더 크다”고 했다. 다른 영남권 후보 측도 “후보 개인 역량으로 뚜벅뚜벅 해나갈 수 밖에 없다”고 했다. 서울, TK(대구·경북), PK(부산·경남) 단체장 측은 독자적인 선대위를 띄우거나 인근 지역과 연대하는 형식의 선대위를 전략으로 구상하고 있다.)

PPP candidates believe that Jang’s remarks about “such acts” are linked to former leader Han Dong-hoon’s independent candidacy in the Busan Buk-gu by-election for the National Assembly. A camp for a metropolitan government head in the central region said, “Because of Representative Jang, an already difficult election is becoming even harder. We need his supporting fire, but instead, he keeps misfiring.” (국민의힘 후보들은 장 대표의 해당 행위 발언을 한동훈 전 대표 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 무소속 출마와 관련한 것으로 보고 있다. 중부권 단체장 후보 측은 “장 대표 때문에 안 그래도 어려운 선거가 더 어려워지고 있다”며 “지원 사격해 줘도 모자랄 판에 헛발질만 한다”고 했다.)

PPP lawmaker Jin Jong-oh, who is aligned with the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, expressed his intention to support Han’s election campaign despite Jang’s remarks about “such acts.” During a radio interview that day, Jin stated, “Former Representative Han said, ‘I’m very grateful for your willingness to help, but I’ll accept it only in spirit.’ Still, even if Han pushes me away, I will go.” Jin has even secured a residence in the Busan Buk-gu area. Earlier, on the 20th, immediately after completing his U.S. trip, Jang ordered an investigation into Jin’s activities. (친한동훈계인 국민의힘 진종오 의원은 장 대표의 해당 행위 발언에도 한 전 대표의 선거 지원을 하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다. 진 의원은 이날 라디오에서 “한 전 대표가 ‘도와주려는 마음은 너무 고맙지만 마음만 받겠다’고 했다”면서도 “한 전 대표가 저를 내치더라도 저는 갈 것”이라고 했다. 진 의원은 북갑에 집도 구했다. 앞서 장 대표는 지난 20일 방미 일정을 마치자마자 진 의원에 대한 진상 조사를 지시한 바 있다.)
